PhD
As a PhD student you will become a part of a research group and carry out independent scientific research including a written dissertation and a public defense of your PhD thesis.
At the Department of Chemical and Biochemical Engineering we conduct research of a high international standard. We have strong competences within both basic research and applied research and pride ourselves on finding industrial solutions that are applicable in both industry and society.
If you are interested in becoming a PhD student at our Department, please check out our "Vacant positions" or contact a member of faculty that works within your area of interest to discuss future possibilities.
You can learn more about our current research activities by visiting our research page, reading "About us" and discovering each of our six research centers:
Danish Polymer Centre
CHEC Research Centre
CoaST Research Centre
PROSYS Research Centre
AT CERE Research Centre
PILOT PLANT Research Centre
